summary: Lead the fate of nations. The award-winning, political roleplaying game.
description:
Step into the fictional Suzerain Universe, a narrative-driven political series from Torpor Games, that explores the complex world of political leadership and decision-making. Whether you take on the role of President in Sordland or King in Rizia, your choices will shape history. Navigate complex decisions and guide your people through pivotal moments across an epic 1.4m-word branching political saga. 

Please note: Suzerain is only available in the English language. 

REPUBLIC OF SORDLAND: Assume the role of President Anton Rayne and guide the nation of Sordland through the challenging times of your first term. Every choice you make has consequences in a world of corruption, political intrigue, economic recession, and international conflict. Will you bring reform, or will you fall into the traps of the past? How will you lead? 

KINGDOM OF RIZIA: Take on the mantle of King Romus Toras and lead Rizia through the challenges of your reign. Your decisions impact shifting alliances, noble rivalries, economic hurdles, and looming threats. Will you restore Rizia's glory through diplomacy or expand its borders by force? Engage with powerful nobles, manage resources, and navigate the complex web of politics. How will you reign? 

Experience the Suzerain Universe: 

- Freemium Model: Play the entire game for free by watching ads. 
- Premium Ownership: Players can purchase individual story packs (Sordland and Rizia). Premium players have full access to their purchased story packs with extra perks such as free story points on purchase, and no ads. 
- Subscription System: Enjoy Suzerain content ad-free with flexible subscription plans ranging from 1-day to 1-month passes. Subscribers gain timed access to both the Republic of Sordland and Kingdom of Rizia story packs. 
- Lifetime Pass: For dedicated fans, the Lifetime Pass offers full access to all current and future content in the Suzerain Universe, ad-free and forever. This includes any future DLC and additional story packs, providing the ultimate premium experience. 

REPUBLIC OF SORDLAND FEATURES: 

Decisions Matter: Make critical decisions on security, economy, welfare, and diplomacy. Your values will be tested beyond the confines of your office. 

Build Your Legacy: Drive Sordland towards one of 9 unique major endings and more than 25 sub-endings. What will your legacy be? 

Duty vs. Personal Values: Witness how your presidential decisions influence the country and your family and relationships. 

Manage the Recession: Take control of the nation's budget and economic growth, and strive to bring Sordland out of an ongoing recession. 

Pass Reforms: Work with politicians to amend the constitution, and sign or veto bills into law. 

KINGDOM OF RIZIA FEATURES: 

New Kingdom, New King: Assume the role of King Romus, the newly crowned leader of the Kingdom of Rizia. Explore South Merkopa, an expansion of the Suzerain Universe. 

Geopolitical Challenges & New Resources: Start dialogues with new national leaders. Will you forge new alliances or make new enemies? Oversee the management of new invaluable resources such as energy and authority. 

A Game of Houses: Engage in discussions on religion, family, and romance. Dive into the intricate dynamics of a royal family and houses where relationships intertwine, merging the realms of love, duty, and politics. 

Build Your Nation: Sign dozens of Royal Decrees on topics such as order, economy, and welfare to develop and improve Rizia. Will you be the guardian of peace or the catalyst for conflict? 

War Mechanic & Military Build-up: Experience the strategic and tactical military challenges in a turn-based experience. Build up the Rizian Armed Forces and train units to intimidate neighbors. 

Rich Character Interactions: Encounter a diverse cast of 20 characters each with unique backgrounds and motivations. 

The fate of nations rests in your hands. Are you ready to lead?
